title: Atari 2600 Pac-Man CX2646 Cartridge - Arcade Game, Good
descriptionText: The 1981 Pac-Man Atari 2600 CX2646 is a classic video game that is part of the iconic Pac-Man series. Released in 1982 by Atari, this arcade-style game is suitable for all ages with an E rating. Made in the United States, this action and adventure game offers players the opportunity to control the popular character, Pac-Man, as he navigates through mazes collecting dots and avoiding ghosts. With its timeless gameplay and simple yet entertaining mechanics, this Atari 2600 version of Pac-Man is a must-have for any retro gaming enthusiast.
